headline: Fire and police transfers of $50,000 each, a $500,000 golf course fund addition, and a Board of Education budget update.
summary: Consent items include money added to the Senior Center, CDBG, and special education funds. Other business includes a bid waiver for Firematic and a comptroller contract authorization.
items: Approval of 2027 meeting calendar
Approval of 2027-2028 budget calendar
Aging: additional appropriation of $17,478 within the Senior Center Activity Fund
ECD: transfer of $50,000 within the CDBG Fund
PRYCS: additional appropriation of $10,000 and transfers totaling $6,906 within the Special Grants and Donations Fund
BECC: transfers totaling $9,000 within the Special Grants and Donations Fund
BOE: additional appropriation totaling $8,856 within the Special Grants and Donations Fund
BOE: additional appropriation totaling $14,744,773 within the Special Education Grant Fund
Police Department: transfer of $50,000 from the General Fund Contingency account
Fire Department: transfer of $50,000 from the General Fund Contingency account
Fire Department: bid waiver to Firematic
PRYCS: additional appropriation of $500,000 within the Chippanee Municipal Golf Course Fund
Board of Education budget update
Comptroller: authorization to countersign contracts as to availability of funding
Banking & Audit subcommittee report for November 20, 2026
Liaison reports
Chairman's report
New business
Old business
For information only
